subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ of the knife in his hand made her sick.
solution:
The correct answer is** "sight".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Here, in the given sentence, Sight means ​'a view; glimpse (एक दृश्य)**'.**

 
 
• ​Example: I faint at the **sight **of blood.
 
 

Therefore, option 2 is the correct answer. 

Complete Sentence__: *The __sight__ of the knife in his hand made her sick.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Site **means a place where something has happened or that is used for something (**वह स्‍थान जहाँ कुछ घटित हुआ या कोई काम हुआ; घटना स्‍थल**).
 
• S**light** means very small; not important or serious (**बहुत छोटा; बड़ा या गंभीर नहीं, मामूली**).
 
• **Cite **means to mention something or use somebody’s exact words as an example to support, or as proof of, what someone is saying (**उदाहरण या प्रमाणस्‍वरूप किसी बात का उल्‍लेख करना या किसी व्‍यक्ति के मूल शब्‍द उद्धृत करना**).
